hooks.name: Re-run unit tests after core module changes
hooks.description: Runs the Python unit tests only when one of the tested core modules or bridge.py is saved.

action.prompt: A tested core module was just saved. Run the unit tests from the build-and-test steering file (the three sphere_scout_ai test scripts, plus tools/xr_viewer/test/test_bridge.py if bridge.py changed), with ROS sourced. Report only failures or a one-line pass. If a test fails, find the cause; do not edit triangulation.py or thermal_render.py to make a test pass without asking first.
